page.overview:
What is The Unforgiven III?

The Unforgiven III is the seventh track on Death Magnetic.

It is a sequel to "The Unforgiven" and "The Unforgiven II" off Metallica (The Black Album) and ReLoad respectively.

"The Unforgiven III" does not start with the horn intro used in the first two. Instead, it has a long piano solo. This is the first Metallica song to have a piano in it, giving it a distinct sound. It is also the first song in the "Unforgiven" trilogy to not be released as a single and to not feature as the fourth track on an album.

How could he know this new dawn's light Would change his life forever? Set sail to sea, but pulled off course By the light of golden treasure
